content_data.meeting_title: Q4 Campaign Performance Review & Holiday Season Strategy Planning
agenda_items: Review streaming platform partnership campaign metrics and ROI analysis
Budget reallocation discussion for underperforming digital channels
Competitive analysis of rival studios' promotional tactics
Discuss brand positioning adjustments for upcoming content releases
key_decisions: Postpone podcast advertising campaign until after holiday season to optimize spend efficiency
Shift 15% of display advertising budget to TikTok and Instagram Reels for younger demographic targeting
Greenlight partnership with three mid-tier gaming influencers for cross-platform content promotion
Approve additional budget allocation of $75K for holiday season out-of-home advertising in key metro areas
Implement A/B testing framework for email campaigns starting in 3 weeks
